en: There is something more important: the villagers are trying to cross the bridge to the village.
Arrest them and take them back to their cells...
... and use force if necessary!"
A letter from the warden... apparently to his officers.
"Gentlemen, it is extremely difficult for me to draft this order.
A sudden illness prevents me from helping you maintain a stable situation on the bridge.
I will join you promptly once the nausea has passed... and once my arms have stopped swelling.
The situation is still under control, do not lose hope!
We can do it if we stand together!
Nothing is impossible if we work as a team!
Unity is strength, and we are united in adversity!
I am proud of you. We can overcome this trial!
I believe in you, I believe in us!"
Sounds like a lesson from "Managing soldiers: How to earn their respect without using torture".
A letter stamped with the King's seal, carefully folded at the back of the safe.
Looks like Castaing finally got the message about posting orders.
"Dammit, how much must I give you to do the job properly? Shut down that bridge once and for all, it's a question of life and death!"
Oh, and that's not all.
The room was completely wrecked.
There was a fight... or someone lost all control.
A gaping body... and an orange substance oozing out of it.
This was more than just a touch of flu.
Oh. I'm afraid I know who it was.
Good old Castaing, always ready for battle!
Hey, a door I don't have to knock down!
Kind of disappointing, actually.
A soldier's report.
"Internal prison security agent Guitou hereby reports...
... that a creature observed to be of large size was sighted emerging from Warden Castaing's office.
... The absence of said warden leads us to conclude that he was almost certainly killed in the line of duty.
... Consequently, my colleagues and I would greatly appreciate the assistance of the royal guard."
A great big room for a great big painting.
The seal of the King is recognizable at the centre, as for the rest...
A pile of old letters, nothing special.
Wait!
One of the letters bears the seal of the King! It's damaged but I can still read it.
"The Giant is not a member... guard anymore.
Take his body to the pris...
... spear in his body should be enough, but make sure... he never wakes up."
Hmm... Apparently, he woke up anyway.
Funny, this big chunk of metal in this storeroom.
The tombstone dropped from the ceiling and...
Dammit!
I recognize this hand.
The poor guy could not escape fate. His lair became his tomb.
Hmm, I understand now why he wanted his rune back.
This room seems to have been added after the construction of the castle.
I've seen this type of shelves before, in the King's castle.
Looks like I had a bad time with it.
This huge skeleton doesn't bode well.
I really wonder who killed him.
He looks way more dead than me.
Yeah, he's not gonna move anytime soon.
Does he really have claws this size?
He's gone INTO the lava? Guess he didn't want to come back after all...
I'm definitely not going in after him!
I think he might have forgotten something...
Specialist Shop.
Responding to the most eccentric of demands for over 15 years and at least eight updates now.
Vaguely religious, these symbols seem to evoke a holy maternal figure...
...and a strange exhortation to consume wine?
"Apparently seeing the dead rise wasn't enough..."
"Today it's the plants that are up and about raising hell."
"The King's new best friend has ordered one of them captured... Alive..."
"...I'd like to see that!"
How did they get the skeleton in the bottle?
"Man vs Wild" and other botanical treatises are spread out on the ground.
I wonder what's in this flask...
It seems like these infected ones were trapped in the trunk...
Makes you wonder who was the sick one in this story...
The skull of a giant crow mixed in with various bits of mushed and mashed organs, entrails and local roots...
...connected to the bark of an old red giant tree.
The perfect evil wizard starter kit...
"WARNING: DON'T WATER THE PLANTS!"
But where does it go?
Varnished wood... satin pillows...
A bunch of leather bound books...
I wonder which noble had their personal garden here.
Gloves, a pitchfork... Maybe a courtier tried their hand at gardening?
No, you wouldn’t find one that would sit on such a shabby piece of furniture.
Or wear this outfit.
It seems the gardener had his entrances into the palace too.
A bulletin board, a note is tacked to it.
"Do not forget to clean the cellar on a regular basis: the meat will not last more than 3 or 4 days, after that it begins to emit a foul odor."
